title: Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
'''Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings''' is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for and . It is located to the south of Quarter Basin Station and the east of Parallel Bay Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Miner Bay Depot and Vector Bay Depot, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to 20 nine-carriage trains.

Description

Sidings

The two sides have 14 sidings in total, which can store 20 trains, including 15 trains and five trains.

Connecting Tracks

The tracks enable trains to standby in both directions, and trains can go directly to Parallel Bay Station or Quarter Basin Station. However, the tracks only lead to Parallel Bay Station as the curvature of curves to Rapid Rivulet Station are too small. Spurs are also set up on each track.

Other Facts

Besides of increasing the capacity for and , this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing dispatch frequencies in mind. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Vector Bay Depot.

safeHtml:
The '''Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development''' is a set of guidelines regarding Island development on West Metropolis Archipelago, Archipelago at Strait of Freedom. Internal Sea Archipelago and Rover Archipelago. This set of guidelines adopt the mode of "Specific Island Application".

English Version

Los Sengas of the City World includes a considerable number of islands. The Officials would like to grant players permission to develop some islands under limited rules. However, in order to maintain stable development of different player-owned islands and island supply, the following regulations apply to the development. Before applying an island, be sure to check out the followings whether you are eligible to apply:

How to apply an island:

When you apply an island, following benefits will be given to you:

When you apply an island, be sure to follow the regulations below:

To conclude your development of an island, please inform me directly at Minecraft or using in-game /mail of your completion. After I inspect your completed island and passed, I will provide you a certificate of your island.

  • Your warning record is less than 2
  • You do not own more than 1 island-class, and 2 isle-class islands in Los Sengas
  • The island you want was not belong to any player
  • Check the map and the owner list below
  • Contact the Chief Administrator Nazca Chan （me）
  • The Chief Administrator will provide you information and the plan of the island and whether you are eligible to apply
  • Tip: If you are not sure the island is available for you, please consider your second choice or further
  • Vague details such as “small city” or ”residential and commerical” etc. are NOT allowed for custom plans （Effective after 7th The First Month, Year 5）
  • You will grant a personal Creative Mode/Survival Mode Command Block switch on the island
  • If the island does not have Nazca Railway Station or Sava Light Transit linked to Nazca Railway Station, teleportation button at spawn will be set for you for quick travel
  • The island will be protected permanently
  • Private Space!
  • Do NOT use the Creative Mode Command Block switch outside the owned island
  • Do follow the plan of the island provided by the Chief Administrator
  • If there are public infrastructures （NR/NFC etc.）, you cannot modify any of their structure
  • Railways and Car-roads are allowed in Island-class island, but are NOT allowed in Isle-class island
  • Do obviously retain the shape of the natural coastline
  • No artificial island built on non-natural island’s continental shelf
  • Shall NOT exceed 9 builders within an island （Owner exclusive）

Citiations and Reference

  • West Metropolis Archipelago

'''Relish Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Location

'''Relish Island''' is located to the southwest of Hakeem Island, the west of Orama Island, the northwest of Leben Island and the east of Xofa. It also sits at the western edge of Centopia.

Transport

Railway

This island features two separate Nazca Railway stations, with Relish North Station serving situated near the north coast of the island and Relish South Station serving situated at the southwest of this island. Both stations serve as a means of access between Xofa and the Nazca Railway Headquarters as a whole.

Roads

(To be Added)

Fun Facts

  • The name of this island '''Relish''' is an English word that can be defined as "Enjoyment" and "Pleasure".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/relish</ref> It also corresponds to the chinese name of this island, which refers to "Discussing something enthusiastically".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%B4%A5%E6%B4%A5%E6%A8%82%E9%81%93</ref>
  • Development on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas due to its close proximity with Xofa District.
  • Coincidentally, the shape of this island resembles the Station Control Room of Havenore Station.

Future Development

Immediately after reclamation works completed on this island, it was already announced that this island would feature a mall named "The American Mall", above which two different towers (Namely "Maple Tower" and "Eagle Tower") are situated, an amusement park named "The Red Carpet", a Park with a fountain, a Future Congress Center, and four parking lots, one along each coast of the island and two adjacent to The American Mall.

History

  • December 23 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • January 7 2024: Relish North Station and Relish South Station began services.
  • August 31 2024: This island completed road pavement.
